definitions.gloss: individually; separately; one by one; case by case
definitions.explanation: Adverbial form of the na-adjective/noun {個別|こべつ} ('individual, separate'). Indicates that an action applies to each person or item one at a time rather than collectively. Common in business, educational, and administrative contexts for describing tailored handling of cases, requests, or instruction.

examples.japanese: {個別|こべつ}に{対応|たいおう}します。
{問題|もんだい}は{個別|こべつ}に{判断|はんだん}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: Each issue needs to be judged on a case-by-case basis.

examples.japanese: ご{質問|しつもん}については、この{会議|かいぎ}のあとで{個別|こべつ}にお{答|こた}えいたします。
examples.english: As for your questions, I'll answer them individually after this meeting.

notes:
Formed from the na-adjective/noun {個別|こべつ} ('individual, separate') + the adverbial particle に. Widely used in formal and business settings to stress that treatment or handling is tailored to each case rather than uniform.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {個別|こべつ}に{対応|たいおう}する: to handle/respond individually
- {個別|こべつ}に{相談|そうだん}する: to consult one-on-one
- {個別|こべつ}に{判断|はんだん}する: to judge case by case
- {個別|こべつ}に{説明|せつめい}する: to explain to each person separately
- {個別|こべつ}に{連絡|れんらく}する: to contact individually
- {個別|こべつ}に{指導|しどう}する: to teach/coach one-on-one

SIMILAR WORDS:
- それぞれ: each, respectively — emphasizes the set as a whole with distinctions; more neutral in tone
- {別々|べつべつ}に: separately — emphasizes not mixing together (e.g., payment, packaging)
- {一人一人|ひとりひとり}: one by one (for people) — stresses the human individual
- {一|ひと}つずつ: one at a time — emphasizes sequential handling of items

CONTRAST:
- {個別|こべつ}に{対応|たいおう}する: respond individually (each case addressed on its own terms)
- まとめて{対応|たいおう}する: handle together/in a batch (the opposite approach)
